mentions.name: Contribution Protocol
mentions.description: A peer-to-peer protocol that replaces capitalist value systems with contribution-based logic, measuring value through actions, prestige (trust), and system response rather than profit. Its model is claimed to be mathematically proven to converge to π, framed as a rational system for real well-being.
mentions.problem: Existing capitalist value systems measure value through profit rather than contribution.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We’re building a P2P protocol that replaces capitalist value systems with contribution-based logic.
It measures value through actions, prestige (trust), and system response—not profit.
